statement: Let $a, b, c, d$ be real numbers with $0 \leq a, b, c, d \leq 1$. Prove that $ab(a-b) + bc(b-c) + cd(c-d) + da(d-a) \leq \dfrac{8}{27}$, and find all quadruples for which equality holds.

Pawns and rooks are placed on a $2019 \times 2019$ chessboard with at most one piece per square. A rook can \textit{see} another rook if they share a row or column with no pieces between them. What is the maximum $p$ for which $p$ pawns and $p + 2019$ rooks can be placed so that no two rooks can see each other?

Two circles $\Gamma_1$ and $\Gamma_2$ intersect at $A \neq Z$, with centers $B$ and $C$ respectively. The exterior angle bisector of $\angle BAC$ meets $\Gamma_1$ again at $X$ and $\Gamma_2$ again at $Y$. Prove that the interior angle bisector of $\angle BZC$ passes through the circumcenter of $\triangle XYZ$.

An integer $m > 1$ is \textit{rich} if for any positive integer $n$, there exist positive integers $x, y, z$ with $n = mx^2 - y^2 - z^2$; otherwise it is \textit{poor}. Find a poor integer and a rich integer.
